title: Culinary fallback illustration

Polished appetizing editorial gouache illustration with realistic food structure and subtle painterly texture. Centered composition, slightly overhead three-quarter view, landscape 4:3 with generous crop-safe margins. Soft natural daylight. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, people or hands. Original illustration, not a photograph; do not copy existing artwork.
